by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h ϑ ih =>
      intro hϑ_gt_0
      cases ϑ with
      | zero => omega
      | succ ϑ_pred =>
          by_cases hϑ_pred : ϑ_pred = 0
          · subst ϑ_pred
            unfold δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat
            intro u hu
            let u₀ : Word A ι := u 0
            let u₁ : Word A ι := u 1
            have hfin : finMapTwoWords u₀ u₁ = u := by
              funext i
              fin_cases i <;> rfl
            rw [← hfin]
            apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines
            rw [prob_uniform_eq_card_filter_div_card] at hu ⊢
            have hcard :
                (Finset.filter
                    (fun r : Fin 1 → F =>
                      Δ₀(multilinearCombine u r, MC) ≤ e)
                    Finset.univ).card =
                  (Finset.filter
                    (fun r : F =>
                      Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation u₀ u₁ r, MC) ≤ e)
                    Finset.univ).card := by
              apply Finset.card_bij (fun r _ => r 0)
              · intro r hr
                simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr ⊢
                rw [← hfin] at hr
                simpa [multilinearCombine, affineLineEvaluation, u₀, u₁] using hr
              · intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hrs
                funext i
                fin_cases i
                exact hrs
              · intro r hr
                refine ⟨fun _ => r, ?_, rfl⟩
                simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr ⊢
                rw [← hfin]
                simpa [multilinearCombine, affineLineEvaluation, u₀, u₁] using hr
            simpa [hcard, Fintype.card_fun] using hu
          · have hϑ_pred_gt_0 : ϑ_pred > 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hϑ_pred
            have ih_pred : δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat
                (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ_pred)
                (e := e) (ε := ε) :=
              ih ϑ_pred (Nat.lt_succ_self ϑ_pred) hϑ_pred_gt_0
            unfold δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat
            intro u hP
            let U₀ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).1
            let U₁ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).2
            let R := R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ_pred) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁
            have hcombine (r_last : F) (r_init : Fin ϑ_pred → F) :
                multilinearCombine u (Fin.lastCases r_last r_init) =
                  multilinearCombine
                    (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init := by
              simp [multilinearCombine, affineLineEvaluation, U₀, U₁,
                splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords]
            have hP' :
                Pr_{ let r_last ← $ᵖ F;
                     let r_init ← $ᵖ (Fin ϑ_pred → F) }[
                  multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
                    (MC := MC) (u := u) (e := e) r_last r_init] >
                  (((Nat.cast (R := ℝ≥0) (ϑ_pred + 1)) * ε : ℝ≥0) /
                    (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0)) := by
              rw [Pr_multi_let_equiv_single_let]
              rw [do_two_uniform_sampling_eq_uniform_prod]
              rw [prob_uniform_eq_card_filter_div_card]
              rw [prob_uniform_eq_card_filter_div_card] at hP
              have hcard :
                  (Finset.filter
                    (fun p : F × (Fin ϑ_pred → F) =>
                      multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
                        (MC := MC) (u := u) (e := e) p.1 p.2)
                    Finset.univ).card =
                  (Finset.filter
                    (fun r : Fin (ϑ_pred + 1) → F =>
                      Δ₀(multilinearCombine u r, MC) ≤ e)
                    Finset.univ).card := by
                apply Finset.card_bij
                  (fun p _ => Fin.lastCases p.1 p.2)
                · intro p hp
                  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp ⊢
                  unfold multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close at hp
                  rw [hcombine]
                  exact hp
                · intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ hp
                  apply Prod.ext
                  · exact congrFun hp (Fin.last ϑ_pred)
                  · funext i
                    exact congrFun hp i.castSucc
                · intro r hr
                  let p : F × (Fin ϑ_pred → F) :=
                    (r (Fin.last ϑ_pred), fun i => r i.castSucc)
                  have hp_eq : Fin.lastCases p.1 p.2 = r := by
                    funext i
                    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
                    · simp [p]
                    · simp [p]
                  refine ⟨p, ?_, hp_eq⟩
                  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr ⊢
                  unfold multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
                  rw [← hcombine, hp_eq]
                  exact hr
              rw [hcard]
              simpa [Fintype.card_fun, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm] using hP
            have hR :
                Pr_{let r ← $ᵖ F}[r ∈ R] >
                  (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
              simpa only [U₀, U₁, R] using
                prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε)
                  (u := u) (e := e) hP'
            have h_affine :
                Pr_{let r ← $ᵖ F}[
                    Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) r,
                      MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred))) ≤ e] >
                  (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
              apply lt_of_lt_of_le hR
              apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
              intro r hr
              have hr_mem : r ∈ R_star_tensor MC (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁ := by
                change r ∈ R
                exact hr
              have hr' := correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
                (MC := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε) (ih := ih_pred) (u := u)
                (r := ⟨r, by
                  change r ∈ R_star_tensor MC (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁
                  exact hr_mem⟩)
              rw [jointProximityNat] at hr'
              change Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) r,
                MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred))) ≤ e
              exact hr'
            have hpow : 1 ≤ 2 ^ ϑ_pred := Nat.one_le_pow ϑ_pred 2 (by omega)
            have h_pair := h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ ϑ_pred) hpow
              (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) h_affine
            unfold jointProximityNat₂ at h_pair
            rw [jointProximityNat] at h_pair ⊢
            rw [Code.closeToCode_iff_closeToCodeword_of_minDist] at h_pair ⊢
            rcases h_pair with ⟨v, hv, hv_close⟩
            let half := 2 ^ ϑ_pred
            let vflat : InterleavedWord A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_pred + 1))) ι :=
              fun j i =>
                if hi : i.val < half then
                  v j (0 : Fin 2) ⟨i.val, hi⟩
                else
                  v j (1 : Fin 2) ⟨i.val - half, by
                    have hi_total := i.isLt
                    dsimp only [half] at hi_total ⊢
                    simp only [Nat.pow_succ] at hi_total
                    omega⟩
            refine ⟨vflat, ?_, ?_⟩
            · simp only [CodeInterleavable.interleaveCode,
                ModuleCode.moduleInterleavedCode] at hv ⊢
              intro i
              by_cases hi : i.val < half
              · simpa [vflat, hi] using hv (0 : Fin 2) ⟨i.val, hi⟩
              · have hi_inner : i.val - half < half := by
                  have hi_total := i.isLt
                  dsimp only [half] at hi_total ⊢
                  simp only [Nat.pow_succ] at hi_total
                  omega
                simpa [vflat, hi, hi_inner] using
                  hv (1 : Fin 2) ⟨i.val - half, hi_inner⟩
            · have hdist :
                  Δ₀(⋈| u, vflat) =
                    Δ₀(⋈| finMapTwoWords (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁), v) := by
                unfold hammingDist
                congr 1
                ext j
                simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
                apply not_congr
                constructor
                · intro hflat
                  funext k t
                  fin_cases k
                  · have ht : t.val < 2 ^ (ϑ_pred + 1) := by
                      have ht' := t.isLt
                      simp only [Nat.pow_succ]
                      omega
                    have hj := congrFun hflat
                      (⟨t.val, ht⟩ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_pred + 1)))
                    simpa [vflat, half, U₀, U₁,
                      splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords, finMapTwoWords,
                      Interleavable.interleave] using hj
                  · have ht : t.val + half < 2 ^ (ϑ_pred + 1) := by
                      have ht' := t.isLt
                      dsimp only [half] at ht' ⊢
                      simp only [Nat.pow_succ]
                      omega
                    have hj := congrFun hflat
                      (⟨t.val + half, ht⟩ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_pred + 1)))
                    simpa [vflat, half, U₀, U₁,
                      splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords, finMapTwoWords,
                      Interleavable.interleave] using hj
                · intro hnested
                  funext i
                  by_cases hi : i.val < half
                  · have hj := congrFun (congrFun hnested (0 : Fin 2))
                      (⟨i.val, hi⟩ : Fin half)
                    simpa [vflat, half, U₀, U₁,
                      splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords, finMapTwoWords,
                      Interleavable.interleave, hi] using hj
                  · have hi_inner : i.val - half < half := by
                      have hi_total := i.isLt
                      dsimp only [half] at hi_total ⊢
                      simp only [Nat.pow_succ] at hi_total
                      omega
                    have hj := congrFun (congrFun hnested (1 : Fin 2))
                      (⟨i.val - half, hi_inner⟩ : Fin half)
                    simpa [vflat, half, U₀, U₁,
                      splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords, finMapTwoWords,
                      Interleavable.interleave, hi, hi_inner] using hj
              rw [hdist]
              exact hv_close
